escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in contract.md is (ticker, depth, peak_date), but REP-01 (covered by M1-T04) says each report row holds the drawdown and both dates, and TC-08's expected.json gives each drawdown a trough_date as well as a peak_date. M1-T04 freezes Drawdown, so freezing it as written would leave M1-T12 (TC-08) and write_report (REP-01) unable to carry the trough date. Proposed Revise: add trough_date: str to risk.Drawdown (invariant: peak_date <= trough_date, both in returns.base_date + returns.dates). A related gap for the same Revise: M1-T04's Writes have no file to hold the new types TickerSummary, Drawdown and Report (risk/types.py was M1-T03's, and risk/__init__.py is M1-T05's), so either add packages/risk/src/risk/types.py to M1-T04's Writes or name the owner modules (summary.py, drawdown.py, report.py) for the types in contract.md.
